thread:
jess_ops: Heads-up - LuminaTech delivered partial APAC order to SG-hub. 18 H100s landed, 6 failed smoke-test. Vendor proposing 4x air-replace to SIN-depot and 2x sea-return. Need routing + expedite cost split. @tom_procurement @lee_logistics


Tom_procurement: Request serials, DOA photos, and a line-item air quote. Also ask vendor to state who handles customs & duties for air. Which ledger to charge? infra-capex or ops-day2?

lee_logistics: Operational note: If air -> route to SIN-depot-1 for bench swap. Depot needs manifest_v4 CSV + 24h pre-alert. No crossdock without approval. ETA ~36h after AWB. Carrier options: SQ / MH.

nora_platform: Capacity note: APAC Dedicated pool = 160 H100s. Losing 6 affects queued training jobs. I'll reserve 2 hot-spares in APAC for 48h if we expedite. Est cost $900/day. Approve?

jess_ops: Vendor note (copied): failures = "no POST / PSU fault" for 6 units. Serials (redacted): H100-LT-701..H100-LT-706. Air quote = $18,400 + customs + insurance. Vendor asks for 45% expedite share and wants Redwood to arrange AWB.

Tom_procurement: 45% is too high. Counter 25% if vendor covers customs + insurance and provides carrier invoice with surcharge breakdown. Require timestamped DOA photos and signed RMA form before expedite payment.

lee_logistics: Pre-alert CSV example (manifest_v4):

```
AWB,Carrier,ShipFrom,ShipTo,ItemCount,Serials,HSCode,DeclaredValue,Insurance,RMA_type
TBD,TBD,LuminaTech,SIN-depot-1,4,"H100-LT-701;H100-LT-702;H100-LT-703;H100-LT-704",84733000,340000,yes,swap
```

Depot will reject format mismatches.

jess_ops: Uploaded preliminary vendor photos & runlogs: https://files.redwood.internal/rma/3754219876/ (placeholder). Chased vendor for carrier invoice.

nora_platform: If vendor accepts 25% + covers customs/insurance, proceed with air and I'll flip on the 2 hot-spares. If vendor refuses, route all 6 back to vendor sea-return and schedule APAC repair lane (~10 business days).

ops_bot: Reminder set - follow up with LuminaTech in 6h if AWB or receipts not provided.

legal_bot: Flagged for legal review if vendor requests non-standard PO clauses or asks Redwood to assume carrier liability. Tagging @tom_procurement/legal-review.

Tom_procurement: Drafting PO amendment: counter = 25% expedite, vendor covers customs/insurance, vendor to provide carrier receipts and DOA sign-off within 6h of ship. Sending now. If vendor rejects, escalate to finance.

jess_ops: Action items:
1) jess_ops - upload full serial manifest + failure logs + DOA photos by 15:00 SGT.
2) tom_procurement - send PO counter + require receipts.
3) lee_logistics - pre-book SIN-depot-1 slot conditional on AWB.
4) nora_platform - reserve 2 hot-spares in APAC pool if AWB issued.
SLA target: 72h E2E from AWB to swap complete. :white_check_mark:

Tom_procurement: If vendor pushes back on customs coverage, escalate to finance. We should not pay >30% expedite without receipts. :thumbsup:
